title: Oily hands from tending the lamp
literal_meaning: When you brighten the lamp, your hand becomes oily.
meaning_odia: ଦୀପକୁ ତେଜିବା ବେଳେ ହାତରେ ତେଲ ଲାଗି ଚିକ୍କଣ ହେବାର ଚିତ୍ର ଏଠାରେ ଅଛି। ଅନ୍ୟର ଅର୍ଥ ବା ସମ୍ପଦର କାରବାର ସମ୍ଭାଳୁଥିବା ଲୋକ ନିଜେ ମଧ୍ୟ କିଛି ଲାଭ ପାଇବାର ଇଙ୍ଗିତ ଭାବେ ଏହାକୁ ପଢ଼ାଯାଇପାରେ। ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟରେ ଏହିପରି ପ୍ରୟୋଗ ଅଛି। ମୂଳ ପିଡିଏଫ୍‌ର ତେଳିଲେ ବଦଳରେ ସେହି ପ୍ରକାଶିତ ପାଠର ତେଜିଲେ ଗ୍ରହଣ କରାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: The hand that tends the lamp comes away with some of its oil. The inspected editorial applies this image to personal gain while arranging expenditure. Our broader reading is that handling resources can bring a benefit to the handler; the saying can carry suspicion about that benefit.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A person entrusted with arranging purchases quietly secures an advantage for themselves. An observer recalls the oily hand that has been tending the lamp.
cultural_context: The image makes contact visible: the lamp is brighter, but oil remains on the hand that tended it. That residue becomes an image of benefit retained by someone managing another matter.

witnesses.note: Uploaded wording is ଦୀପ ତେଳିଲେ ହାତ ଚିକ୍କଣ। Display changes only ତେଳିଲେ to ତେଜିଲେ using the cited public counterpart; this is an explicit editorial repair, not the uploaded visual reading. ମୂଳର ତେଳିଲେ ବଦଳରେ ପ୍ରକାଶିତ ସମାନ ପାଠର ତେଜିଲେ ଗ୍ରହଣ କରାଯାଇଛି।

witnesses.locator: Paragraph on publicity and banner expenditure quoting the proverb; subsequent intermediary paragraph. Inspected17November2026.
